description: Turek Believes Preventing Tax Hikes on Iowans is a “Threat” Grimes, IA – Yesterday, local leaders and Iowa taxpayers gathered in Grimes to express their support for Iowa Amendment 1 and denounce Josh Turek’s vote to make it easier for politicians to raise their taxes. Josh Turek voted against advancing Iowa Amendment 1 to the November ballot, opting to let politicians indiscriminately raise taxes on Iowans. Working Iowans already squeezed by high prices should have certainty that their taxes won’t go up. Josh Turek can’t even do that — he wants higher taxes and it will only push families down further. He is a typical liberal politician who thinks he knows how to spend Iowans’ hard-earned money better than they do. KCCI coverage of the press conference can be viewed HERE. A transcript can be found below. “The Republican Party of Iowa is standing firm on Amendment One and attacking Ashley Hinson’s congressional opponent, Democrat Josh Turek. Amendment One is on the November 3rd ballot, proposing a constitutional change.
